name: Tormented (Crushing)

items.name: Endless Suffering
items.text: The tormented was crushed or broken on the wheel.

items.name: Tortured Gaze
items.text:
30 foot or 60 foot if the tormented is at 125 HP or lower.

The psychic agony of a tormented spills into the world around them, inflicting murderous hallucinations replicating the tormented's last moments. A non-undead creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 32 Will save save or take 4d8 bludgeoning damage and be knocked Prone. While it has a condition from Tortured Gaze, a creature can't gain a new condition from the aura but can take damage from it again.

items.name: Scream in Agony
items.text:
Each creature in the tormented's Tortured Gaze aura takes 14d6 mental damage (DC 34 basic Will save). A creature that fails is also Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

The tormented can't Scream in Agony again for 1d4 rounds, but recharges the ability whenever they take damage from an attacker's critical hit or their own critical failure on a saving throw.

text: Twisted caricatures of living beings, tormented arise from the remains of those who've been tortured to death. They appear as the mortals they were in life, horribly disfigured by acts of cruelty. Unable to rest, they haunt the sites of their deaths, doomed to relive their last moments of agony. The toxic psychic residue of their death is so great it spills over, afflicting anyone who meets the tormented's haunted gaze.
